notes.title: Tennis Fighters Big Update!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Tennis Fighters Community!

We are excited to bring you a brand-new update packed with exciting features and improvements. Here’s what’s new:[/h3]


[h3][b]New Logo: [/b][/h3]
We’ve got a fresh new look! We hope you like it and share it with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/e81628ae693f0935843ebd8486c2e559a9eaf751.png[/img]

[h3][b]Split Screen Mode:[/b][/h3]
Enjoy offline multiplayer with the new “Split Screen” mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/c2c514bce991fa1d13f271b417f27da3df446f7d.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Improved Gameplay Mechanics:[/b][/h3]
New mechanics have been added to make gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/3782f8fad7c2627692562598d190e5fe5ae8a793.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New Languages:[/b][/h3]
We’ve added support for several new languages to enhance your gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/bb55e32bf40175540785363ea3c2fd7f44f0db06.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Keyboard & Controller Support: [/b][/h3]
Now you can play using a keyboard, Xbox, Switch PRO, and PS4 controllers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/3bca4fc6e662d63da689e91135c6868a31fe50c6.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Skip Scene Feature:[/b][/h3]
Easily skip scenes during “points” with the new “Skip Scene” feature.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
Several gameplay bugs and issues have been fixed for a smoother experience.

Follow us on Instagram for the latest updates and news: https://www.instagram.com/tennisfighters/

Thank you for your continued support and see you on the Tennis Court!

notes.title: New Major update!
notes.content:
Good morning "Tennis Fighters"!

Today we announce a big update to our game in order to improve the game, add more content and teach how to play it. So here are the main points.

[h1]NEW Modes[/h1]
[h2]Academy[/h2]
Our goal is to make game with the perfect balance between sim & arcade, but we noticed that several players don't know how to play or just don't know how to make all the shots. So we created an "Academy" where you will find tutorials and "lessons" to complete in order to learn and know how to play the game (shots, movements, etc...) Our intention is to keep adding more lessons, so we are waiting for your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/615ec8606b052338eeeeb48f6d125f925c427048.png[/img]

[h2]World Tour[/h2]
This offline mode is an "arcade mode" where you will play against all the Fighters in the game in a random way (court/daytime) and once you will win all, you will be the champion. Each round has a "chrono", so be sure to beat all your opponent in the less time as possible to be the one in the "world raking".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/dc6eddfa72a4d0816cc150f70124e8f17c64e4fa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/e4ae8cd557872f44a2c96a7902ca67dde62ffa11.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/cce7c9fac78818460466371d62a17699369a2f5e.png[/img]

[b]Daytimes:[/b] Morning / Afterooon / Night

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36390471/0a223bac18560de94ea687c886b7482023721fb1.png[/img]


[h1]Several Fixes [/h1]
- Added custom sounds for female
- Added several music for main game 
- Fixed several "menu" bugs
- Added the "controls image" into the loading screen
- Improved the AI
- Added the "difficult level" into the "Training Screen"

[h1]Special Price![/h1]
In order to involve more people in the game and know your feedback, we have set a cheaper price. : )

So, we hope that you like all this stuff we are adding, and we really want to know your feedback. Also, if you want to join the game and collaborate we are open!

See you Fighters!
